records.source: [NPC] Clerk Seraphine: Welcome to the mayor elections!
[NPC] Clerk Seraphine: Democracy has never been this simple!
[NPC] Clerk Seraphine: Everyone votes for their favorite candidate...
[NPC] Clerk Seraphine: ... and whoever has the most votes becomes mayor for a year!
[NPC] Clerk Seraphine: The elected mayor offers perks for everyone!
[NPC] Clerk Seraphine: We're still decorating since the building renovations!
[NPC] Clerk Seraphine: The Community Center will be finished soon!
[NPC] Clerk Seraphine: Check back later for updates!
[NPC] Clerk Seraphine: This is going to be our Village's Community Center!
[NPC] Clerk Seraphine: Right now, it's under construction.
[NPC] Clerk Seraphine: Check back later to view leaderboards and the latest news!
[NPC] Spaceman: Have you heard of the Garden?
[NPC] Spaceman: Well I'm sure you'll have your own soon enough.
[NPC] Spaceman: When you do, come talk to me.
[NPC] Spaceman: So you've got your own Garden, but are you shotting for the Stars?
[NPC] Spaceman: Serve 3,000 Visitors in your Garden and then come back.
[NPC] Spaceman: From up here I'm able to see all the Gardens in SkyBlock.
[NPC] Spaceman: All the crops...all the Visitors...
[NPC] Spaceman: Your Garden seems particularly of note, however.
[NPC] Spaceman: You've accepted offers from well over 3,000 Visitors...
[NPC] Spaceman: If you were to invite me to visit, I would not say no.
[NPC] Taylor: Ah, a Bachelor's Rose? You want to view my exclusive Garden skin collection?
[NPC] Taylor: Unfortunately I only visit the Gardens of the best farmers in SkyBlock.
[NPC] Taylor: If you can reach the DIAMOND bracket in each of Jacob's Farming Contests, then we'll talk adventurer!
